pick.headline: Gorbachev accepts German unity in talks with Kohl
pick.summary: On February 10, 1990, Chancellor Helmut Kohl said after talks in Moscow that Gorbachev had agreed that the Germans themselves should decide on unity.
pick.significance: Moscow's acceptance removed the main obstacle to German unification, which took place in October 1990.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of February 12, 1990, carried a report that Shevardnadze briefed Warsaw Treaty foreign ministers on Gorbachev's Sunday talks with Kohl and Genscher, with the ministers saying German reunification required particular responsibility.
